value.rationale: The canonical smallest triangle-free four-chromatic Mycielskian graph is a motivated test bed for two distinct localization protocols. Their equal optimal cost and strictly nested optimum five-set spaces create a natural physical-mobility comparison. An exact 3-slide worst-case penalty, affecting 60 pairs, and the full 5995-pair distribution quantify a meaningful deployment tradeoff not supplied by known upper-bound results.
